title: Boeing's Engineers Could Ground the 777X, Delta's Very Bad Day With a Casket, and United's Polaris Lounges Can't Keep Up
summary: Boeing's engineers might walk out October 6th, and that could freeze the already-years-late 777X right when it needs to get certified. Plus, a heartbreaking story about Delta mishandling a family's loss, United's new 787s are so popular in business class that the lounges can't handle the crowd, and Finnair is about to fly one of the longest scheduled routes in the world.
